scripts.text: Welcome to the Treasure Hunters Guild {0}.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到宝藏猎人公会，{0}。

scripts.text: Look {0}, you can only 1 quest at a time, you should finish the quest unless you have given up.
scripts.translation: 听着，{0}，你一次只能接取一个任务。除非决定放弃，否则就把任务完成。
放弃任务需要支付^FF00002500 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: No, never would I leave a quest!
Good well get back out there.
Its sad to see someone give a quest up...
scripts.translation: 看到有人放弃任务真令人难过...

scripts.text: Thats sad you don't even have ^FF00002500z^000000.
scripts.translation: 真可悲，你连^FF00002500 Zeny^000000都没有。
啊，欢迎你，宝藏猎人同伴。

scripts.text: Would you like me to assign you a Quest?
Yes I would like a Quest Please.
Ok lets see what quest we can give you today.
scripts.translation: 好，来看看今天有什么任务可以交给你。

scripts.text: The quest names in ^FF0000This Colour^000000 mean that they are more challenging then the rest, but have better rewards.
scripts.translation: 标为^FF0000这种颜色^000000的任务难度更高，但报酬也更丰厚。

scripts.text: I'm afraid you must sign up for the guild before you can go on a quest!
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，加入公会后才能接取任务！

scripts.text: I'm afraid there aren't any Quests for you yet.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，目前还没有适合你的任务。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: This is an easy and low payed quest.
scripts.translation: 这是个简单但报酬不高的任务。

scripts.text: A wife came in asking us to find his husband, she seems to come in a lot asking us to find him over and over again.
scripts.translation: 有位妻子来委托我们寻找她的丈夫。她似乎经常来，反复拜托我们找人。

scripts.text: But he always seems to be around the same place so there isn't much looking involved,check the mountains 1 west and 1 north of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 不过他好像总在同一个地方，所以不难找。去普隆德拉西边1张地图、北边1张地图的山里看看。

scripts.text: This is just a package delivery run, no big deal or anything.
scripts.translation: 只是送个包裹而已，没什么大不了的。

scripts.text: Take this to an archer in the Archer Village outside of Payon.
scripts.translation: 把这个送给斐扬城外弓箭手村的一位弓箭手。

scripts.text: In this quest you get to see some action.
scripts.translation: 这个任务能让你活动活动筋骨。

scripts.text: There has been a farmer that keeps having all his crops eaten by ^FF0000Thief Bugs, Porings, and Lunatics^000000 here is a lost of what I need you to do. He is waiting East of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 有位农夫的庄稼总被^FF0000盗虫、波利和疯兔^000000吃掉。这是需要你处理的清单。他在普隆德拉东边等你。

scripts.text: Ok go to the east and bash those little bastards like there is no tomorrow. When you are done with that list you have just discard it, but you will NOT get another one!.
scripts.translation: 好，去东边把那些小混蛋狠狠教训一顿。清单上的目标完成后就把清单丢掉，不过可不会再给你一份！

scripts.text: This is just another quest with possible well pay.
scripts.translation: 这又是一份报酬不错的任务。

scripts.text: There is an old Widow in Prontera, she recently lost her husband due to a monster attack.She has requested a Guild member to come talk to her at the Prontera Graveyard.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉有位年迈的寡妇，她的丈夫最近遭魔物袭击身亡。她想请公会成员到普隆德拉墓地和她谈谈。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。
送给杰拉迈亚的刺击拳刃

scripts.text: I do not know much about this quest.
A strange man came in here yesterday and asked me to deliver this ^FF0000Strange Letter^000000 to some woman in Morocc. Knowing us we do not ask questions so you must take care of this delivery.
scripts.translation: 昨天有个奇怪的男人来这里，拜托我们把这封^FF0000奇怪的信^000000送给梦罗克的一位女士。我们向来不问缘由，所以这件差事就交给你了。

scripts.text: The Woman is in located in Morocc and her name is Erika.
scripts.translation: 那位女士在梦罗克，名叫艾丽卡。

scripts.text: Jeramiah ordered a Special Jur from our weapon shop.Your Job is to deliver it to him in the Assasin Temple.
scripts.translation: 杰拉米亚向我们的武器店订购了一把特制短剑。你要把它送到刺客神殿交给他。

scripts.text: Strange man in the marsh need your help.
scripts.translation: 沼泽里有个奇怪的男人需要你的帮助。

scripts.text: There is a strange man in the forest in ^FF00001 south and 1 west^000000 of Prontera, he need your help with something.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉南边1张地图、西边1张地图的森林里有个奇怪的男人^FF0000需要你帮忙^000000。

scripts.text: There is a woman in Payon that is in desperate for aid.
scripts.translation: 斐扬有位女士急需帮助。

scripts.text: There is a woman in Payon named Molly please get to her as soon as possible the letter she sent here sounded like someone was killing her.
scripts.translation: 斐扬有位叫莫莉的女士。请尽快去找她，她寄来的信听起来像是有人要杀她。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: Have you ever been to Hell?
A man outside of ^FF0000Ant Hell^000000 has requested your audience, I suggest you hurry.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000蚂蚁地狱^000000外有个男人想见你，我建议你赶快过去。

scripts.text: In this quest you need to deliver a mystery box to someone names ^FF0000Flank at the bridge between Aldebaran and Juno^000000.
scripts.translation: 这次你要把一个神秘箱子送给^FF0000艾尔帕兰和朱诺之间桥上的弗兰克^000000。

scripts.text: The ^FF0000Prontera Culvert^000000 is out of control!Sign up as a volunteer to clean out some of the culvert.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000普隆德拉地下水道^000000已经失控了！报名当志愿者，帮忙清理一下。

scripts.text: I know it seems like there is no stopping them but however many you kill does makes a difference. After you have signed up, inside the Culvert there will be a Knight that will give you a quest.
scripts.translation: 虽然看起来它们无穷无尽，但每消灭一只都有意义。报名后，在下水道里你会遇到一位骑士，他会给你发布任务。

scripts.text: The fun...err...trouble never stops in Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 卢恩-米德加兹的欢乐...呃...麻烦从来不会停歇。

scripts.text: Recently there was an accident at the coal mines. There was a huge chasm that released some undead Evil Druids.
scripts.translation: 最近煤矿发生了事故。一道巨大的裂缝释放出了一些不死邪恶德鲁伊。

scripts.text: The Evil Druids started to turn all the workers into the undead. We do not know why, but we do not want to find out, contact a man named Rudolfo outside the Coal Mines.
scripts.translation: 暗神官开始将工人们变成亡灵。我们不知道原因，也不想知道。请去煤矿外找一位名叫鲁道夫的男子。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: The undead have invaded Payon Cave!
scripts.translation: 不死系魔物入侵了斐扬洞穴！

scripts.text: I remember when Payon Cave used to be a safe place to visit, but now undead Zombies have infested the cave! Please contact ^FF0000Flora outside on Payon Cave^000000 and aid her.
scripts.translation: 我记得斐扬洞穴以前是个安全的地方，如今却被僵尸占据了！请联系^FF0000斐扬洞穴外的芙萝拉^000000，帮帮她。

scripts.text: Proto-type of a Staff must be delivered to Zed the Wizard.
scripts.translation: 需要把法杖原型送给巫师泽德。

scripts.text: Zed the Wizard has requested to try out a new un-named proto-type staff. It will be your job to deliver this to him. Zed tend to stay within the general area of Juno.
scripts.translation: 巫师泽德想试用一把尚未命名的新法杖原型。你的任务就是把它送给他。泽德通常在朱诺一带活动。

scripts.text: A little girl is in trouble.
scripts.translation: 一个小女孩遇到了麻烦。

scripts.text: There is a little girl in trouble, her name is Dassy and she is ^FF0000east of the Prontera fountain^000000.
scripts.translation: 有个名叫达西的小女孩遇到了麻烦，她在^FF0000普隆德拉喷泉东边^000000。

scripts.text: This is a strange quest that I know little about.
scripts.translation: 这是个奇怪的任务，我不太了解。

scripts.text: Someone in ^FF0000Prontera Guild Hall^000000 has requested to see one of our members, his name is Czhore.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000普隆德拉公会大厅^000000有人想见我们的成员，他叫克佐尔。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: Easy for some very hard for others.
scripts.translation: 有人觉得简单，有人却觉得很难。

scripts.text: A man named Lithin wishes to give you a quest, you can find him north of Prontera inside of ^FF0000The Hidden Temple^000000
scripts.translation: 一个名叫利辛的男人想交给你任务。他在普隆德拉北边的^FF0000隐秘神殿^000000里。

scripts.text: Its funny cause no one knows how these were really made.
scripts.translation: 说来有趣，没人知道这些金字塔究竟是如何建成的。

scripts.text: Apparently the Pyramids have are beginning to be infested with undead activity,outside the pyramids a man will be waiting for you. He did no give us his name but he asked for you to hurry.
scripts.translation: 据说金字塔里开始出现大量不死系魔物。金字塔外有个男人在等你。他没告诉我们名字，只让你尽快赶去。

scripts.text: This sounds like another one of those ditzy girl quests...
scripts.translation: 听起来又是那种迷糊女孩的委托...

scripts.text: Dazzy the local blond around Geffen has asked for you to deliver her these flowers. I don't know why someone would send flowers to herself...
scripts.translation: 吉芬当地的金发女孩达西拜托你把这些花送给她。我真不懂怎么会有人给自己送花...

scripts.text: Well no one ever said Casper was nice behind the scenes.
scripts.translation: 谁也没说过卡斯帕私底下是个好人。

scripts.text: A wizard on the 3rd floor of Geffen tower wants to talk to you about the ancient ruins underneath the city.
scripts.translation: 吉芬塔三楼有位魔法师想和你谈谈城市地下的古代遗迹。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: Deliver this Box to the Thieves guild.
scripts.translation: 把这个箱子送到盗贼公会。

scripts.text: More undead action in this triangle!
scripts.translation: 这个三角地带又有不死系魔物作乱！

scripts.text: Talk to a man outside the entrance of the pyramids, he seems to have another quest for you.
scripts.translation: 和金字塔入口外的男人谈谈，他似乎还有其他任务要交给你。

scripts.text: Well most of what we do is run packages, this is no different from other's.
scripts.translation: 我们的工作大多是送包裹，这次也没什么不同。

scripts.text: Take this box, DO NOT OPEN IT! To a little girl in Lutie named Chirach she should be around Santa.
scripts.translation: 把这个箱子送给卢蒂一个叫奇拉奇的小女孩，千万别打开！她应该在圣诞老人附近。

scripts.text: The little children of Geffen have been having strange nightmares.
scripts.translation: 吉芬的孩子们最近一直做奇怪的噩梦。

scripts.text: We believe that the ruins underneath Geffen are causing this problem, talk to a Wizard named Zuuzuu inside Geffen Tower for your mission.
scripts.translation: 我们认为这是吉芬地下遗迹造成的。去吉芬塔里找一位叫祖祖的魔法师，他会告诉你任务详情。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: Can't say no to some good apple juice.
scripts.translation: 美味的苹果汁谁能拒绝呢？

scripts.text: There is a little girl up in Prontera Square a bit north from the fountain, go talk to her.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉广场喷泉稍北边有个小女孩，去和她谈谈。

scripts.text: So many packages so little time.
scripts.translation: 包裹这么多，时间却不够。

scripts.text: Take this box to a man in Alberta named Charles.
scripts.translation: 把这个箱子送给艾尔帕兰一个叫查尔斯的男人。

scripts.text: The Prontera Culvert has never been the same...
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉地下水道再也回不到从前了...

scripts.text: Well there have been reports of a Golden Thief Bug running around the bottom of the Culvert. Talk to a Knight inside the Culvert.
scripts.translation: 有人报告说黄金盗虫在地下水道底层四处乱窜。去和地下水道里的骑士谈谈。

scripts.text: A ghost ship has washed up on shore on an island outside of Izlude.
scripts.translation: 一艘幽灵船漂到了伊兹鲁德外海的一座岛上。

scripts.text: A female assassin has a quest for you, she is waiting outside the Ghost Ship. There have been reports of evil undead pirates lurking around inside the ship.
scripts.translation: 一位女刺客有任务交给你，她正在幽灵船外等候。据报船里有邪恶的不死海盗出没。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: Sound gross to some good to others.
scripts.translation: 有人觉得恶心，也有人觉得好喝。

scripts.text: There is a little girl up in Prontera Square a bit north from the fountain, go talk to her.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉广场喷泉稍北边有个小女孩，去和她谈谈。

scripts.text: Well yah box delivering is in high demand,lots of lazy people.
scripts.translation: 送箱子的活儿需求真大，懒人可真不少。

scripts.text: Take this package to a man in Morocc named Klye.
scripts.translation: 把这个包裹送给梦罗克一个叫克莱的男人。

scripts.text: Hidden in the Temple he watches and guards.
scripts.translation: 他藏身神殿之中，守望并守护着。

scripts.text: Rumor has it that a Goat Man is lurking in the Hidden Temple, There is also a man in the Hidden Temple names Zack that needs you help with this Goat Man known as Baphomet.
scripts.translation: 传闻隐秘神殿里潜伏着一个山羊人。神殿里还有个叫扎克的男人，需要你帮忙对付这个名为巴风特的山羊人。
太好了，我闻到了愚蠢的气息...

scripts.text: A little girl in Payon wants to talk to you, her name is Flower, What a stupid name,Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 斐扬有个小女孩想和你谈谈，她叫花儿。这名字真傻，哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: Oh god please get this out of here fast.
Oh man smells like someone died in here.Take this to the Magic School in Geffen and hurry,ahh the smell its burning my eye's!!!
scripts.translation: 天啊，闻起来像有人死在里面了。快把它送到吉芬魔法学校...这气味熏得我眼睛都疼了！！！

scripts.text: Hmmm seems a man named Jack wants to speak to you in the Archer Guild House.
scripts.translation: 嗯，看来一个叫杰克的男人想在弓箭手公会里见你。

scripts.text: Well what we know about Payon is that a while ago there was a freak fire that burnt down the old school.
scripts.translation: 我们只知道斐扬以前发生过一场奇怪的大火，烧毁了旧学校。

scripts.text: The strange thing about what happened was that the children inside did not seem to die from the flames.
scripts.translation: 奇怪的是，里面的孩子似乎没有死于火灾。

scripts.text: Speak to the little school girl somewhere in Payon.
scripts.translation: 去斐扬找那个小女孩谈谈。

scripts.text: Hmmm seems a man named Jack wants to speak to you in the Archer Guild House.
scripts.translation: 嗯，看来一个叫杰克的男人想在弓箭手公会里见你。

scripts.text: Well I don't know much about this, it has to do with the deepest regions of Payon Cave, We don't know much because no one ever seems to make it back alive.
scripts.translation: 我不太了解这件事，只知道和斐扬洞穴最深处有关。我们知之甚少，因为似乎没人能活着回来。

scripts.text: Hmmm seems a man named Jack wants to speak to you in the Archer Guild House.
scripts.translation: 嗯，看来一个叫杰克的男人想在弓箭手公会里见你。

scripts.text: The farther we go into the cave the stranger it gets.
scripts.translation: 越深入洞穴，里面就越奇怪。

scripts.text: Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation: 好，这里有几个你能完成的任务。

scripts.text: There is nothing written on this box but a notice to deliver it to a man Kreg.
scripts.translation: 箱子上什么也没写，只贴着一张纸条，要求交给一个叫克雷格的男人。

scripts.text: Tony the Tiger is on crack and destroying the forest.
scripts.translation: 老虎托尼发疯了，正在破坏森林。

scripts.text: Talk to a man outside the 'Hidden' Hunter Guild, He needs your help.
scripts.translation: 去找“隐秘”猎人公会外的男人，他需要你的帮助。

scripts.text: He is big and Pink and you run and hide!
scripts.translation: 它又大又粉红，见到就快逃！

scripts.text: This guy just poped into some hole one day, He doesn't look that tough but you would be surprised. Talk to a man named Caral outside of Ant Hell.
scripts.translation: 这家伙有一天突然从某个洞里冒出来。别看它好像不厉害，你会大吃一惊的。去找蚂蚁地狱外一个叫卡拉尔的男人。

scripts.text: This half naked freak need an army to take down, now its your job, good luck. Meet a girl named Jeni outside of the back entrance to Ant Hell.
scripts.translation: 这个半裸的怪物需要一支军队才能打倒，现在轮到你了。祝好运。去蚂蚁地狱后方入口外找一个叫杰妮的女孩。
